quick_english: For one endowed with karmic residue, causal status would hold in embodied existence.

tokens.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound referring to the aṇu endowed with karmic residue; analyzed as given, no internal split.
abstract noun marking the property of being a cause in this doctrinal context.
connective linking the preceding causal claim to the conditional clause.
optative/conditional form marking a doctrinally posited possibility rather than a stated fact.
locative of bhava marking the sphere of embodied existence for the aṇu.

quick_english: This is established by reasoning: there is no other distinct effect; that is the meaning.

tokens.grounds: Past-participle compound marking a conclusion established by reasoning, not by direct perception.
Negated pronoun used to exclude an alternative item from the set under consideration.
Refers to a distinct effect different from one already posited in the argument.
Clausal marker giving the intended meaning of the preceding reasoning as a whole.

quick_english: And the afflictions of varied and noble forms arise for those attached to objects.

tokens.grounds: Fused form as given; marks afflictions appearing in varied and noble forms. Internal fusion noted, not split into rows.
Connective joining the forms of afflictions to the class of those affected.
Technical term for the kleśas in Śaiva Siddhānta, load-bearing and not reducible to a generic emotion.
Genitive plural describing those bound by attachment to objects, i.e. the class on whom those afflictions arise.

quick_english: This will be shown in another section; thus, auspiciousness.

tokens.grounds: Locative marking a different section of the present work, not a different text.
Future passive/impersonal future marking a promised demonstration within the work's own structure.
Clausal closure marking the end of the present argument unit.
Auspicious closure formula common to doctrinal verse units; here marks closure, not a new premise.
